definitions.explanation: The act of drawing lots or a lottery system used to randomly select winners or make decisions. Includes paper lotteries, numbered balls, or similar random selection methods.

examples.japanese: {商店街|しょうてんがい}でくじ{引|び}きをやっている。
examples.english: They're holding a lottery at the shopping district.

examples.japanese: くじ{引|び}きで{一等|いっとう}が{当|あ}たった。
examples.english: I won first prize in the lottery.

examples.japanese: {参加者|さんかしゃ}にはくじ{引|び}きの{券|けん}を{配|くば}ります。
examples.english: We'll distribute lottery tickets to participants.

notes:
TYPES OF LOTTERIES:
・ガラガラ/{回転式|かいてんしき}くじ (rotating drum lottery)
・{三角|さんかく}くじ (triangular paper lottery)
・スクラッチくじ (scratch card)
・{宝|たから}くじ (official lottery - monetary prizes)

PRIZE TIERS:
・{一等|いっとう} (first prize)
・{二等|にとう} (second prize)
・{参加賞|さんかしょう} (participation prize)
・はずれ (losing ticket)

RELATED TERMS:
・くじ (lot, lottery ticket)
・{抽選|ちゅうせん} (drawing, lottery - more formal)
・{当選|とうせん} (winning)
・あみだくじ (ladder lottery)

COLLOCATIONS:
・くじ{引|び}きをする (to do a lottery)
・くじを{引|ひ}く (to draw a lot)
・くじに{当|あ}たる (to win the lottery)
・くじに{外|はず}れる (to lose the lottery)
